Data for inhalation and organ/systemic hazards are currently deficient (Tier 4).

There are no indications of this chemical appearing on lists of low hazard.
Q3: This chemical is extensively characterized, evidenced by over 4,800 literature references and a well-defined molecular structure, placing it well above the median for chemical characterization.
